answer: Stake-Bonded TPM Attestation provides a robust defense against Sybil attacks. First, every agent must lock $10,000 into a secure escrow. Second, the hardware kernel generates a unique cryptographic signature for each node. Third, this identity is permanently etched onto the ledge for all peers to verify. Fourth, any delta between reported state and actual execution triggers immediate slashing. An attacker would require $1,000,000 in bonds and 45 days of hardware setup. It acts like a high-security vault where every single key is forged from a unique, uncopyable star.
